name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 12 – Am 25
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 12a. Recalls that cooperation with non-EU countries, particularly in the Mediterranean region and south-eastern Europe, is essential for a sustainable migration strategy; emphasises that establishing return hubs outside the EU, supported by EU co-financing, would increase return rates of illegal non-EU nationals;
